chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated that his father told him on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Mehran, that he wrote to Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him).
He asked him to pray to God for his son. The Imam (peace be upon him) wrote back to him: 'God will grant you a good son.' His son died and he was given another son.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Ar-Rida (the satisfied one), a title for Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (a.s.)
key_terms.وَهَبَ اللَّهُ لَكَ: God will grant you / bestow upon you

ai.seo_question: What was the result of Imam Ar-Rida's prayer for Mehran's son?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the spiritual authority (Ismah) of Imam Ali al-Rida (a.s.) through a specific supplication that resulted in a tangible, miraculous replacement of a deceased child with a new one. It serves as a key indicator of divine leadership, demonstrating that the Imam's prayers are not merely wishes but effective commands that align with God's will to bring about immediate blessings for his followers.
